title: Janji Bank & Matchday 1
notes: Source of truth for Episode 6. Frame-0 red bank stamp slam on NOTIS SITA. Bank Promise signed in ClubOffice, then Matchday 1 vs Taktik Jaya FC loses 0-2 and the debt holds at RM331,500 (loss pays RM0). No match bonus. Ends on the standard 72-frame Buluh FC / EPISOD 6 card. No CTAs.

scenes.name: Act 1 — Janji Bank
scenes.visual: Frame 0: red NOTIS SITA folder and a heavy stamp slam onto BOS's desk. Karim's vacant gold armband sits beside it. Peguam slides the seizure notice across; Bos negotiates the one-season freeze in exchange for the Divisyen 5 title.
scenes.sfx: stamp slam at frame 0; paper slide; pen taps as the deal is signed.
scenes.bgm: Low-tension office drone, ducked under dialogue.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Notis sita. Tiga puluh hari dah lepas.
lines.translation: Seizure notice. Thirty days are up.

lines.speaker: PEGUAM
lines.text: Masa awak habis, bos. Stadium ni milik bank.
lines.translation: Your time is up, boss. This stadium belongs to the bank.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Kasih satu musim lagi. Kami akan juara Divisyen 5.
lines.translation: Give us one more season. We'll win Divisyen 5.

lines.speaker: PEGUAM
lines.text: Juara atau sita. Kalah, kosong ringgit.
lines.translation: Champions or seized. Lose, and you get nothing.

scenes.name: Act 2 — Matchday 1
scenes.visual: 2.7s StartingXICard sells the full 11, then kickoff vs neon-green Taktik Jaya FC. Without Karim the midfield is disorganised; Kapten Zaki struts and mocks. MatchHUD ticks 0-2.
scenes.sfx: kickoff whistle; crowd murmur; boot-on-ball kicks; net swish on both goals.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Matchday satu. Tanpa Karim, Buluh FC macam tak ada nakhoda.
lines.translation: Matchday one. Without Karim, Buluh FC has no helmsman.

lines.speaker: KAPTEN ZAKI
lines.text: Kau tak ada kapten? Bagus la. Kami nombor satu.
lines.translation: No captain? Even better. We're number one.

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Azam! Tekan! Jangan bagi dia ruang!
lines.translation: Azam! Press! Don't give him space!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dua gol. Satu lawan. Dan lampu sorot bank masih menyala.
lines.translation: Two goals down. And the bank's spotlight is still on.

scenes.name: Act 3 — Last-Ditch Block
scenes.visual: Azam throws his body in front of a shot at the touchline; camera cuts to the bench where Peguam sits behind Jurulatih, tapping his watch. DebtTickerHUD flashes NEUTRAL at RM331,500 — a loss pays RM0.
scenes.sfx: block thud; sharp whistle; watch-tap ticks; neutral HUD sting.
scenes.bgm: Tense bed swelling under the neutral debt hold.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Minit ke-89. Azam nampak satu peluang untuk berhenti akhir.
lines.translation: 89th minute. Azam sees one chance to stop the rot.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Tak lepas. Hari ini tak lepas.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Di tepi padang, Peguam tengok jam. Dia tak perlu cakap apa-apa.
lines.translation: On the touchline, the lawyer checks his watch. He doesn't need to say a word.

scenes.name: Buluh FC Series Outro
scenes.visual: Standard black Buluh FC / EPISOD 6 card. No CTA.
